meta.name: The Supreme Person
meta.outline: Verses 1–5: the upside-down peepal tree of worldly life, and the axe of non-attachment; 6: Krishna's home, which no sun lights; 7–11: the soul, a part of Krishna, as it takes and leaves bodies; 12–15: Krishna as the light of the sun, the strength of the earth, the fire of digestion and the one seated in every heart; 16–20: the perishable, the imperishable, and the Supreme Person beyond both.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्
words: they speak of an everlasting peepal tree
whose leaves are the Vedic hymns
whoever knows it knows the Vedas
verses.tr: Krishna said: They speak of an everlasting peepal tree with its roots above and its branches below, whose leaves are the Vedic hymns. Whoever knows this tree knows the Vedas.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: अधः च ऊर्ध्वं प्रसृताः तस्य शाखाः
its branches spread downward and upward
with the objects of the senses as their buds
binding people to action in the human world
verses.tr: Its branches spread downward and upward, fed by the gunas, with the objects of the senses as their buds. Its roots also stretch downward, binding people to action in the human world.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: न रूपम् अस्य इह तथा उपलभ्यते
its form is not seen here as it is
न अन्तः न च आदिः न च सम्प्रतिष्ठा
nor its end, its beginning or its foundation
this peepal tree with its deep roots
having cut it down with the strong axe of non-attachment
verses.tr: Its real form cannot be seen here, nor its end, its beginning or its foundation. Cut down this deep-rooted tree with the strong axe of non-attachment.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: then that goal must be sought
from which those who reach it never return
तम् एव च आद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये
“I take refuge in that first Person”
from whom this ancient activity has flowed
verses.tr: Then seek that goal from which no one returns, saying: “I take refuge in that first Person, from whom this ancient stream of activity has flowed.”

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: having conquered the fault of attachment
freed from the pairs known as pleasure and pain
the undeluded reach that eternal goal
verses.tr: Free from pride and delusion, having conquered the fault of attachment, always dwelling in the Self, with their desires stilled and freed from the pairs called pleasure and pain, the undeluded reach that eternal goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः
यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
words: the sun does not light it
having gone there, they do not return
verses.tr: The sun does not light that place, nor the moon, nor fire. Those who go there do not return. That is my supreme home.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: becomes the eternal living soul in the world of the living
the senses, with the mind as the sixth
which rest in nature, it draws to itself
verses.tr: An eternal part of me becomes the living soul in the world of the living. It draws to itself the five senses and the mind, the sixth, which rest in nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the lord of the body, the soul
it takes these along and goes
as the wind carries scents from their source
verses.tr: When the soul, the lord of the body, takes a body and when it leaves one, it carries these along, as the wind carries scents from their source.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च
words: presiding over these and the mind
it experiences the objects of the senses
verses.tr: Presiding over hearing, sight, touch, taste and smell, and also the mind, it experiences the objects of the senses.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्
words: whether it is leaving or staying
or experiencing, joined with the gunas
the deluded do not see it
those with the eye of knowledge see
verses.tr: The deluded do not see it, whether it is leaving the body, staying in it, or experiencing the world through the gunas. Those who have the eye of knowledge see it.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: but those whose minds are not prepared, even if they strive
do not see it, lacking understanding
verses.tr: Yogis who strive see it living within themselves. But those whose minds are not prepared and who lack understanding do not see it, even if they strive.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the light that is in the sun
and lights up the whole world
that which is in the moon and in fire
know that light to be mine
verses.tr: The light of the sun that lights up the whole world, and the light in the moon and in fire: know that light to be mine.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः
words: I support all beings with my strength
becoming the moon, full of sap
verses.tr: Entering the earth, I support all beings with my strength. Becoming the moon, full of life-giving sap, I nourish all plants.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: living in the bodies of living beings
joined with the breath going in and out
I digest the four kinds of food
verses.tr: Becoming the fire of digestion, I live in the bodies of living beings. Joined with the breath that goes in and out, I digest the four kinds of food.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: I am seated in the heart of everyone
from me come memory, knowledge and their loss
वेदैः च सर्वैः अहम् एव वेद्यः
I alone am to be known through all the Vedas
I am the author of Vedanta
and I am the knower of the Vedas
verses.tr: I am seated in the heart of everyone. From me come memory, knowledge and the loss of both. I alone am to be known through all the Vedas. I am the author of Vedanta, and I am the knower of the Vedas.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च
words: there are two kinds of person in the world
the unchanging is called the imperishable
verses.tr: There are two kinds of person in this world: the perishable and the imperishable. All beings are the perishable. The unchanging is called the imperishable.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: but there is another, the highest Person
verses.tr: But there is another, the highest Person, called the supreme Self: the unchanging Lord, who enters the three worlds and supports them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः
words: because I am beyond the perishable
and higher even than the imperishable
अतः अस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः
I am known in the world and in the Veda
verses.tr: Because I am beyond the perishable, and higher even than the imperishable, I am known in the world and in the Veda as Purushottama, the Supreme Person.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: whoever, undeluded, knows me in this way
and worships me with their whole being
verses.tr: Whoever, free from delusion, knows me in this way as the Supreme Person knows everything, Arjuna, and worships me with their whole being.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रम् इदम् उक्तं मया
so I have taught this most secret teaching
and has done all there is to do
verses.tr: So I have taught you this most secret teaching, Arjuna. Whoever understands it becomes wise and has done all that there is to do.
